summary: A recycler shows a council member why strong sales of one recovered material cannot establish demand for another.
realLife: Allen reported healthy markets for several metals and glass while his plastic and newsprint business struggled.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: material-specific receipts and sales.

turns.what: The recycler brings separate invoices to the committee.
turns.pulledBy: The city evaluates the ordinance using separate material totals.
turns.writesBack: A weak plastic market is visible beside healthy metal sales.

turns.what: A member asks why a strong sales total coincides with a full plastic storage bay.
turns.pulledBy: The council receives only a combined revenue total.
turns.writesBack: A member requests the breakdown before judging the program.
